# dvls_application (Data Source)

A DVLS application account (application identity).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup by ID
data "dvls_application" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# Lookup by application key
data "dvls_application" "by_key" {
  name = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# Lookup by display name
data "dvls_application" "by_full_name" {
  full_name = "Example Application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `full_name` (String) The display name of the application. Exactly one of `id`, `name` or `full_name` must be set.
- `id` (String) The ID of the application. Exactly one of `id`, `name` or `full_name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The application key. Exactly one of `id`, `name` or `full_name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `is_administrator` (Boolean) Whether the application is a DVLS administrator.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the application is enabled.
- `user_groups` (Set of String) IDs of the user groups the application belongs to.
